## [1.2.1](https://github.com/RyuuseiAkira/w3s-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1) (2026-11-26)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* enable any-version compatibility and harden matchers for future versions ([b0b1996](https://github.com/RyuuseiAkira/w3s-patches/commit/b0b1996d1d388fdd529a20a11f97f8587374791b))

patches.name: Bypass forced updates
patches.description: Prevents remote minimumClientBuild version lockouts and disables Play in-app review prompts on sideloaded builds.

patches.name: Disable tracking and analytics
patches.description: Disables Meta AppEvents, AdServices attribution, AAID/InstallReferrer harvesting, and RevenueCat diagnostic telemetry while preserving login and billing.

patches.name: Enable developer tools
patches.description: Unlocks the hidden Billing Debug and Developer Console screens in Settings without switching away from production APIs.

patches.name: Hide upgrade prompts
patches.description: Hides the Explore plans upsell card on the Streak screen and the Go unlimited link in Code Duel.

patches.name: MicroG-RE support
patches.description: Redirects Google Play Services and Credential Manager to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) with package and signature spoofing so Google Sign-In works on re-signed builds.

patches.name: Unlimited energy
patches.description: Bypasses client-side energy consumption, reports full charges, and shows the unlimited energy UI.

patches.name: Unlock curriculum map
patches.description: Unlocks sequential lessons, checkpoints, and milestones on the curriculum map and removes overview unlock upsell banners.
